risk: Existing methods already resolve the proposed contribution
mitigation: Compare complete closest methods and strong combined baseline
trigger: No distinct mechanism or practical headroom

risk: Permitted trade-offs are mislabeled as failures
mitigation: Declare workload domain weights and tolerance before evaluation
trigger: Outcome classification depends on post hoc requirements

risk: Historical task environments are expensive or impossible to reproduce
mitigation: Pin versions and run bounded feasibility inventory
trigger: Environment work consumes the pilot without enough diverse tasks

risk: Noise or repeated selection produces misleading timing evidence
mitigation: Independent confirmation A/A controls controlled runner and appropriate inference

risk: Final audit inputs influence optimizer or selector tuning
mitigation: Separate protected audit evidence and record all feedback
trigger: Audit data used in a method revision

risk: Selector appears better only by rejecting useful candidates or omitting overhead
mitigation: Report useful acceptance and full costs at matched budgets
trigger: Advantage disappears with complete cost accounting

risk: Selected scientific Python tasks do not represent broader service workloads
mitigation: State domain limits and split by project where feasible
trigger: Evidence concentrated in one repository or transformation

risk: Dataset licensing or full artifact access is unresolved
mitigation: Audit source licenses and artifact availability before use
trigger: Needed source or redistribution permission is unavailable

risk: More rounds are confused with causal edit interactions
mitigation: Record all candidates and validate representative reversions
trigger: Single edit or task difficulty explains the alleged interaction

risk: Publication and thesis expectations exceed available two-year resources
mitigation: Early supervisor review and six-week decision gate
trigger: Required study scope exceeds feasible budget or institutional deadlines
